text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We keep seeing chained vendor blips: cloud transient -> auth spikes -> model-registry timeouts -> brief user errors. Need owners + dates for remediation. Who can take point? :mag:
aj: I can own the remediation tracker and coordinate rotations. I'll make a sheet with owner, priority, status, SLA mapping. Can someone export 90d incidents filtered by vendor?
liam: I'll run the queries and produce a vendor-week heatmap (include deploys/time-of-day). ETA EOD.
sre_lead: Please audit circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff; our retries may be amplifying failures. Add "failure mode" and "short-term mitigation" columns to the tracker.
kate: I'll map runbooks to observed failures and propose patches for model-registry token jitter and cross-region retry gaps. Draft by Tue AM.
security: I'll validate KMS/key rotation windows and token TTLs. If rotations are synchronized, we may be seeing auth surges; I'll propose jittering by Monday.
aj: Actions (claim with :white_check_mark:):
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owner tags) due 2026-04-15
- LIAM: vendor heatmap + 90d extracts due 2026-04-13
- KATE: runbook gap doc + patches due 2026-04-14
- SECURITY: rotation review + jitter proposal due 2026-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: CB & autoscaler config review due 2026-04-16
- TEAM: monthly dependency failover drill proposal due 2026-04-20
liam: ack. I'll attach the query and script. Example: `journalctl -u svc-model-registry | grep -E "(timeout|401|503)" > /tmp/registry-errors.log` then run heatmap tool.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0413-07 linked; created tracker DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned AJ.
sre_lead: Short-term mitigations to evaluate:
1) Per-route fallback to cached snapshot (v1-small) when registry latency >200ms for short windows.
2) Synthetic canary every 12h to validate failover and surface drift.
Prototype rule for router: `if registry_latency_ms > 200 and error_rate > 0.02: route -> cached_snapshot:v1-small; notify -> #incidents`
kate: For the drill, propose a scoped "auth-provider burst" scenario to measure time-to-fallback, alert coverage, and user error delta. I'll draft the drill runbook.
security: Adding vendor-SLA mapping to the tracker so runbooks align with contract coverage.
aj: Also will create a recurring calendar item "dependency resilience review" and rotate owners monthly. Volunteers for first rotation?
maria: Thanks — two asks: add postmortem link in tracker and mark infra fallbacks as blocker. I'll schedule Wed 09:00 sync to review heatmap + tracker. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. Tag @maria or @aj if blocked. :calendar: :eyes:
